title: World Bank Group
definition: The World Bank Group (WBG) is a specialized agency of the United Nations comprising five closely associated international institutions that provide financial and technical assistance to developing countries for poverty reduction and economic development.
importanceInUpsc: Frequently tested in UPSC Prelims regarding institutional memberships, lending windows, and publications. Highly relevant for Mains GS-II (International Organizations, Global Financial Architecture) and GS-III (Inclusive Growth, Infrastructure Financing).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of World Bank Group.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
